title: Hybrid plant-meat products – addressing the sustainability debate around processed meat consumption: a review
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00723B, Review Article
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Zuo Song, Ruth M. Hamill, Joseph P. Kerry
HPM products combine plant-based ingredients with meat to enhance taste, texture, and nutritional quality. This review investigates formulation and processing technologies, and explores the challenges and opportunities in their development.
